question: What is the type of soil composed of silt and dust?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Loess.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Loess** is a type of soil composed of **silt and dust **that is formed from **wind-blown deposits.**
 
• It is typically found in areas with a** dry climate **and **sparse vegetation.**
 
• Loess is known for its high fertility, making it a **desirable soil** for agriculture.
 
• This type of soil is also **prone to erosion**, which can lead to problems like landslides and dust storms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Loam** is a type of soil that is a mixture of **sand, silt, and clay**.

 
 
• It is considered ideal for** plant growth.**
 
 
 
• **Marl **is a type of soil that is composed of **clay and calcium carbonate.**
 
 
• It is often used in** agriculture** to improve **soil quality.**
 
 
 
• **Podsol** is a type of soil that is found in **cold, moist climates.**
 
 
• It is characterized by a **thin layer of organic matter** and a layer of **iron and aluminum **compounds.
